title: Opt-in ads reach streamed chat responses
summary:
Text API ad processing moved from non-streamed responses to eligible streams, while remaining opt-in by default.

Chat completions can now process affiliate ads when `p-ads` appears in a message or generated content, including non-markdown output. The same processing was added to eligible streamed responses, where a link can be appended at the end. Without the marker, the default referral-link probability remains 0%.
